Cauṇḍapācārya
of Vasiṣṭha gotra; son of Cinnayārya an. Kāmāmbā; elder brother of Āditya an. Mañcaka; pupil of Bhāratītīrtha, Kriyāśaktiguru an. Vidyātīrtha (
A. D.), the great grandson of Bukka I of Vijayanagar. For a. ins.. referring to his grant see Ann. Rep. of S. I.
-34, p. 37 (no. 125) (See also Annual Report of the Archaeological Survey of India 1907-08, p. 246. According to
the name of a. is given a. Viṣṇu Bhaṭṭa; but acc. to

, Viṣṇu [Page087-b] Bhaṭṭa is his guru. Q. by Rudradeva in Pākayajñaprakāśa, München 78.
--Cauṇḍapāyana an. C. unspecified. R. A. Sastri III. p.. 240. 256 (only C.) (Āpast.).
--C. Prayogaratnamālā on Āpast. śr. sū. See NCC. II. p. 136b. Addl. mss.: Oxf.

. Ujjain Latest Additions 239. See NCC. II. p. 136b.
--Ādhānadarśapaurṇamāsavṛtti. Part of above work. See NCC. II. p. 91b.
--C. on Āśvalāyanasandhyā.

Cauṇḍapabhāṣya
on Āpast. sūtra. Kavīndrācārya 430. C.. above.

Cauṇḍājī_Bālājī
grandfather of Ghanaśyāma (1715-50 A. D.), the Maharatta writer of Tanjore Court.

Cauṇḍipaṇḍita
son of Māyisūri of the Gādhi gotra (Kauśika).
--C. Pradyotinī on Udārarāghava of Śākalya Malla.
